input.quote: 14.1 As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services. No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.
input.rationale: The IP package sits at our preferred position, so no redline is warranted. §14.2 gives us ownership of each Deliverable created specifically for us and an express present assignment by Vendor of all worldwide right, title and interest (plus personnel assignments and further-assurance). §14.3 confirms Vendor retains only Vendor Technology (defined in §1.9 as its pre-existing technology, expressly excluding Customer Data and our pre-Effective Date IP), and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the §13.2 licence, which is "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid" to use, modify and create derivative works for our business. §14.1 confirms we own all Customer Data and that no right transfers to Vendor beyond processing solely to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for us — service delivery rather than independent exploitation — reinforced by §15.1's bars on sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training absent our written consent. §14.4 creates no joint ownership absent a separately signed instrument that identifies exploitation rights, and feedback use is limited to generalized suggestions with our own rights unrestricted. Two points short of ideal wording are noted only, not flagged: ownership/licence are conditioned on payment of applicable Fees, and §13.3 permits suspension of a licence during a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity — a narrow, standard qualification on the stated irrevocability.
